leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply conditional logic to determine which CSS classes should be active based on component state.
Use template literals to construct dynamic class strings with conditional expressions.
Implement ternary operators to toggle between two class options based on boolean conditions.
Execute logical AND operators to conditionally include classes when specific conditions are met.
Utilize object literals to map condition names to boolean values for class inclusion.
Construct class strings by combining static classes with conditionally added dynamic classes.
Define TypeScript interfaces to type-check props that accept conditional class configurations.
Handle multiple conditional classes by chaining logical operators within template literals.
Return JSX elements with dynamically generated className attributes based on component logic.
Access component state and props to drive conditional class decisions within render logic.
Modify existing class strings to add or remove classes based on changing state values.
Control UI appearance by applying conditional classes that respond to user interactions.
